2608.22479.title: GTA-RAG: Graph-Trajectory-Augmented Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning
2608.22479.paper_summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enables LLMs to access external knowledge for answering knowledge-intensive questions. For complex multi-hop questions, multi-turn retrieval-augmented reasoning extends RAG into an iterative process that repeatedly searches for and integrates evidence across documents. However, existing reinforcement-learning (RL) approaches for agentic RAG are typically optimized with final-answer rewards, which provide sparse supervision and overlook whether the model actually retrieves the required evidence chain. We present \textsc{GTA-RAG}, a graph-trajectory-augmented RL framework for multi-turn retrieval-augmented reasoning. From an entity--document graph, we sample connected document paths, synthesize multi-hop QA trajectories, and validate them with the deployed retriever to obtain executable trajectory-level supervision. We then optimize the retrieval policy with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and a trajectory-guided reward that encourages both accurate answers and acquisition of target evidence documents, followed by answer-reward training on natural QA instances. Experiments on three multi-hop and two simple QA benchmarks show that \method{} consistently outperforms RL-based RAG baselines with both Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen2.5-7B backbones, while substantially improving evidence-chain coverage. Our code is available at https://github.com/cjcj46262/GTA-RAG.
2608.22479.paper_summary_zh: 檢索增強生成（RAG）使大型語言模型（LLMs）能夠訪問外部知識，以回答知識密集型問題。對於複雜的多跳問題，多輪檢索增強推理將 RAG 擴展為一個迭代過程，該過程不斷搜索並整合文檔中的證據。然而，現有的強化學習（RL）方法通常以最終答案獎勵進行優化，這提供了稀疏的監督，並忽略了模型是否實際檢索到所需的證據鏈。我們提出了 \textsc{GTA-RAG}，這是一個用於多輪檢索增強推理的圖軌跡增強 RL 框架。從實體-文檔圖中，我們抽樣連接的文檔路徑，合成多跳問答軌跡，並通過部署的檢索器驗證它們，以獲得可執行的軌跡級監督。然後，我們使用群體相對策略優化（GRPO）和一個軌跡引導獎勵來優化檢索策略，該獎勵既鼓勵準確的答案，又促進目標證據文檔的獲取，隨後在自然問答實例上進行答案獎勵訓練。在三個多跳和兩個簡單問答基準上的實驗顯示，\method{} 在 Qwen2.5-3B 和 Qwen2.5-7B 主幹上始終優於基於 RL 的 RAG 基準，同時顯著提高了證據鏈的覆蓋率。我們的代碼可在 https://github.com/cjcj46262/GTA-RAG 獲得。
